articles.title_en: Disentangling Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
articles.title_cn: 区分道德风险与逆向选择
articles.abstract_en: While many real-world principal-agent problems have both moral hazard and adverse selection, existing tools largely analyze only one at a time. Do the insights from the separate analyses survive when the frictions are combined? We develop a simple method—decoupling—to study both problems at once. When decoupling works, everything we know from the separate analyses carries over, but interesting interactions also arise. We provide simple tests for whether decoupling is valid. We develop and numerically implement an algorithm to calculate the decoupled solution and check its validity. We also provide primitives for decoupling to work and analyze several extensions. (JEL D82, D86)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管许多现实中的委托-代理问题同时包含道德风险和逆向选择，现有工具大多仅能逐一分析。当摩擦结合时，单独分析得出的见解是否仍然成立？我们开发了一种简单的方法——解耦——来同时研究这两个问题。当解耦有效时，我们从单独分析中得知的一切都会延续，但也会出现有趣的相互作用。我们提供了检验解耦是否有效的简单测试。我们开发并数值实现了一种算法来计算解耦解并检验其有效性。我们还提供了解耦可行的原始条件，并分析了几个扩展。(JEL D82, D86)

articles.title_cn: 退休消费与养老金设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes consumption to evaluate the distributional effects of pension reforms. Using Swedish administrative data, we show that on average, workers who retire earlier consume less while retired and experience larger drops in consumption around retirement. Interpreted via a theoretical model, these findings imply that reforms incentivizing later retirement incur a substantial consumption smoothing cost. Turning to other features of pension policy, we find that reforms that redistribute based on early-career labor supply would have opposite-signed redistributive effects, while differentiating on wealth may help to target pension benefits toward those who are vulnerable to larger drops in consumption around retirement. (JEL E21, G51, H23, H55, J22, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过分析消费来评估养老金改革的分配效应。利用瑞典行政数据，我们表明，平均而言，较早退休的工人在退休期间消费较少，并且在退休前后消费下降幅度更大。通过理论模型的解释，这些发现意味着激励延迟退休的改革会带来显著的消费平滑成本。转向养老金政策的其他特征，我们发现基于早期职业生涯劳动供给进行再分配的改革将产生相反符号的再分配效应，而根据财富进行区分可能有助于将养老金福利瞄准那些在退休前后容易遭受较大消费下降的人群。（JEL E21, G51, H23, H55, J22, J26）

articles.abstract_en: How did countries recover from the Great Depression? In this paper, we explore the argument that leaving the gold standard helped by boosting inflationary expectations, lowering real interest rates, and stimulating interest-sensitive expenditures. We do so for a sample of 27 countries, using modern nowcasting methods and a new data-set containing more than 230,000 monthly and quarterly observations for over 1,500 variables. In those cases where the departure from gold happened on well-defined dates, inflationary expectations clearly rose in the wake of departure. Instrumental variable, difference-in-difference, and synthetic matching techniques suggest that the relationship is causal. (JEL E31, E32, E42, E43, F30, N10, N20)
articles.abstract_cn: 各国是如何从大萧条中复苏的？在本文中，我们探讨了脱离金本位制通过提升通胀预期、降低实际利率以及刺激利率敏感型支出来帮助复苏的论点。我们基于一个包含27个国家、超过230,000个月度和季度观测值以及超过1,500个变量的新数据集，运用现代即时预测方法进行了分析。在那些脱离金本位制发生在明确日期的案例中，通胀预期在脱离后明显上升。工具变量法、双重差分法和合成匹配法表明这种关系是因果性的。（JEL E31, E32, E42, E43, F30, N10, N20）

articles.title_en: The Economic Impact of Depression Treatment in India: Evidence from Community-Based Provision of Pharmacotherapy
articles.title_cn: 印度抑郁症治疗的经济影响：基于社区提供药物治疗的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates the impact of depression treatment on economic behavior in Karnataka, India. We cross-randomize pharmacotherapy and livelihoods assistance among 1,000 depressed adults and evaluate impacts on depression severity, socioeconomic outcomes, and several potential pathways. When combined, the interventions reduce depression severity, with benefits that persist after treatment concludes. Pharmacotherapy alone has a weaker effect that is only marginally significant and dissipates sooner. Depression treatment does not significantly increase earnings, consumption, or human capital investment in children. (JEL I12, I15, I18, J13, J22, J31, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了印度卡纳塔克邦抑郁症治疗对经济行为的影响。我们在1,000名抑郁成年人中交叉随机分配药物治疗和生计援助，并评估对抑郁严重程度、社会经济结果以及几个潜在途径的影响。当干预措施结合时，抑郁严重程度降低，且益处持续到治疗结束后。单独药物治疗的效果较弱，仅边缘显著且消散更快。抑郁症治疗并未显著增加收入、消费或儿童人力资本投资。(JEL I12, I15, I18, J13, J22, J31, O15)

articles.title_en: Market Power and Innovation in the Intangible Economy
articles.title_cn: 无形经济中的市场势力与创新
articles.abstract_en: This paper offers a unified explanation for the slowdown of productivity growth, the decline in business dynamism, and the rise of market power. Using a quantitative framework, I show that the rise of intangible inputs, such as software, can explain these trends. Intangibles reduce marginal costs and raise fixed costs, which gives firms with high-intangible adoption a competitive advantage, in turn deterring other firms from entering. I structurally estimate the model on French and US micro data. After initially boosting productivity, the rise of intangibles causes a decline in productivity growth, consistent with the empirical trends observed since the mid-1990s. (JEL D22, D24, E23, L11, O31, O47)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为生产率增长放缓、商业活力下降和市场势力上升提供了一个统一的解释。通过一个定量框架，我表明无形投入（如软件）的兴起可以解释这些趋势。无形投入降低了边际成本并提高了固定成本，这使得高无形投入采用的企业具有竞争优势，进而阻止其他企业进入。我在法国和美国的微观数据上对模型进行了结构估计。在最初推动生产率提高之后，无形投入的兴起导致生产率增长下降，这与自1990年代中期以来观察到的经验趋势一致。（JEL D22, D24, E23, L11, O31, O47）

articles.title_en: Competing to Commit: Markets with Rational Inattention
articles.title_cn: 竞争性承诺：理性疏忽的市场
articles.abstract_en: Two homogeneous-good firms compete for a consumer’s unitary demand. The consumer is rationally inattentive and pays entropy costs to process information about firms’ offers. Compared to a collusion benchmark, competition produces two effects. As in standard models, competition puts downward pressure on prices. But, additionally, an attention effect arises: the consumer engages in trade more often. This alleviates the commitment problem that firms have when facing inattentive consumers and increases trade efficiency. For high enough attention costs, the attention effect dominates the effect on prices: firms’ profits are higher under competition than under collusion. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L12)
articles.abstract_cn: 两家同质商品企业竞争消费者的单位需求。消费者是理性疏忽的，并支付熵成本来处理关于企业报价的信息。与合谋基准相比，竞争产生两种效应。与标准模型一样，竞争对价格施加下行压力。但此外，还出现了一种注意力效应：消费者更频繁地进行交易。这缓解了企业在面对疏忽消费者时所面临的承诺问题，并提高了交易效率。对于足够高的注意力成本，注意力效应主导了价格效应：竞争下的企业利润高于合谋下的利润。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L12）
